import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/file_processors/%7Bitem_type%7D/%7Bitem_id%7D/pages/edit/status/%7Boperation_id%7D")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
